stories.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
stories.body: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

stories.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
stories.body: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

stories.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
stories.body: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

stories.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
stories.body: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

stories.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
stories.body: A mathematician at Anthropic says he used an AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take some time.

stories.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
stories.body: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".

stories.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
stories.body: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.

stories.title: Mamdani announces plan to close New York's Rikers Island jail by 2032
stories.body: Plans to shutter the troubled facility date back to 2019, when the city council first voted to close it but delays arose over where to place inmates.

stories.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
stories.body: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

stories.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
stories.body: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

stories.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
stories.body: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.

stories.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
stories.body: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.

stories.title: Texas death-row inmate screams as execution takes more than one hour
stories.body: This prolonged execution comes weeks after Christa Pike survived the lethal injection of the same drug.

stories.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones' daughter says parents warned her about 'nepo baby' label
stories.body: Carys Douglas, 23, made her stage debut this year in Anton Chekhov's play, The Seagull, in the US.

stories.title: South Korea catches 111 students with new measures against exam cheating
stories.body: The students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam.

stories.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East
stories.body: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, which includes three video clips recorded in 2020, 2023 and 2026.

stories.title: What the new UK-EU deal could mean for future post-Brexit relations
stories.body: The BBC's political and Europe editors analyse the new agreements between the UK and EU.

stories.title: Cost of living protests sweep across Europe
stories.body: Thousands marched across European cities on Friday to protest against the cost of living and other issues.

stories.title: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
stories.body: Russia struck bridges and railway stations in the capital Kyiv in a major attack.

stories.title: From premature baby to social media star - Famed hippo Fiona dies
stories.body: The beloved hippopotamus died days after swallowing a knitted hat that accidentally got into her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo.
